briefdescription.para: Benchmarks for distributed analytics coordinator safety controls.

detaileddescription.para: Release Gates: DC-01: Circuit breaker state transition ≤ 100µs DC-02: Concurrent merge startup ≤ 500µs (p99) DC-03: Timeout recovery switchover ≤ 1000µs (p99) DC-04: Degraded-mode throughput ≥ 80% of normal
